entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'd like to start a return for an order I received a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF-774-901.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the VeloPro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them?
They just don't seem to be the right fit for my feet. I spent a while setting up the cleats and thought they felt okay, but after my first long ride, I got some pretty bad blisters on my heels.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment.
Okay, Alex, I see here that you received the cycling shoes 15 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.

That's great news, thank you. A full refund sounds perfect. Since I'll still need to buy another pair and will be paying for the return shipping, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase? I'd like to try a different model from VeloFit.

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad you're sticking with VeloFit for your next pair. Unfortunately, I'm not able to generate a separate discount code on a return transaction. However, I have just processed the return authorization and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email, so you won't have to worry about the shipping cost.
Oh, a prepaid label? I didn't expect that. That works for me. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Alex. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
